context_thinking_control: run_context_suite does not forward thinking_mode or reasoning_effort; model default applies, unlike run_agentic_suite which supports explicit controls
completion_budget: output_headroom_tokens is the total API completion cap; it is not an enforced visible-only allocation
calibration: One max_tokens=1 endpoint calibration call precedes scored cases; its termination is not a scored context check
scoring: Require every scored observation and curve acceptance plus actual usage counts. Completed job alone is insufficient.
near_limit_multimodal: Existing multimodal corpus parser caps prompt characters; separate long text and vision results do not prove combined near-limit multimodal requests
